mapper.sql: w.id, w.org_id AS orgId, w.name, w.slug, CASE WHEN w.lifecycle_state = 'active' AND o.lifecycle_state = 'active' THEN 'active' ELSE 'tearing_down' END AS lifecycleState
mapper.select: SELECT FROM workspace w JOIN organization o ON o.id = w.org_id WHERE w.org_id = #{orgId} AND w.id = #{workspaceId}

SELECT id, orgId, name, slug, lifecycleState FROM ( SELECT w.id, w.org_id AS orgId, w.name, w.slug, CASE WHEN w.lifecycle_state = 'active' AND o.lifecycle_state = 'active' THEN 'active' ELSE 'tearing_down' END AS lifecycleState, 0 AS targetOrder FROM workspace w JOIN organization o ON o.id = w.org_id WHERE w.org_id = #{orgId} AND w.id = #{workspaceId} UNION ALL SELECT t.workspace_id AS id, t.org_id AS orgId, t.workspace_name AS name, t.workspace_slug AS slug, 'tearing_down' AS lifecycleState, 1 AS targetOrder FROM tenant_cleanup_tombstone t WHERE t.org_id = #{orgId} AND t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ) lifecycle_target ORDER BY targetOrder LIMIT 1

SELECT org_id FROM ( SELECT w.org_id, 0 AS targetOrder FROM workspace w WHERE w.id = #{workspaceId} UNION ALL SELECT t.org_id, 1 AS targetOrder FROM tenant_cleanup_tombstone t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ) lifecycle_route ORDER BY targetOrder LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM organization o JOIN workspace w ON w.org_id = o.id WHERE o.id = #{orgId} AND w.id = #{workspaceId} AND o.lifecycle_state = 'active' AND w.lifecycle_state = 'active' FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM organization o JOIN workspace w ON w.org_id = o.id WHERE o.id = #{orgId} AND w.id = #{workspaceId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT workspace_id AS id, org_id AS orgId, workspace_name AS name, workspace_slug AS slug, 'tearing_down' AS lifecycleState FROM tenant_cleanup_tombstone WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, name, slug, lifecycle_state AS lifecycleState FROM organization WHERE id = #{orgId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM organization WHERE id = #{orgId} AND lifecycle_state = 'active' FOR SHARE

SELECT id, orgId, name, slug, lifecycleState FROM ( SELECT w.id, w.org_id AS orgId, w.name, w.slug, CASE WHEN w.lifecycle_state = 'active' AND o.lifecycle_state = 'active' THEN 'active' ELSE 'tearing_down' END AS lifecycleState FROM workspace w JOIN organization o ON o.id = w.org_id WHERE w.org_id = #{orgId} AND w.id > #{afterWorkspaceId} UNION ALL SELECT t.workspace_id AS id, t.org_id AS orgId, t.workspace_name AS name, t.workspace_slug AS slug, 'tearing_down' AS lifecycleState FROM tenant_cleanup_tombstone t WHERE t.org_id = #{orgId} AND t.workspace_id > #{afterWorkspaceId} ) lifecycle_workspaces ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM org_member WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND org_role = 'owner' FOR SHARE )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_operation_lease (org_id, workspace_id, lease_kind, lease_token) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{workspaceId}, #{leaseKind}, #{leaseToken})
INSERT INTO tenant_cleanup_tombstone (workspace_id, org_id, workspace_name, workspace_slug) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{orgId}, #{workspaceName}, #{workspaceSlug})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tenant_cleanup_tombstone WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data_subject_request WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND status NOT IN ('closed', 'refused')
mapper.update: UPDATE data_subject_request SET subject_workspace_id = NULL, subject_person_id = NULL WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND subject_workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM organization WHERE id = #{orgId} AND lifecycle_state = 'tearing_down'
